Flextime account, digital report book, overtime calculator & working-time record.

main.gleitzeitkonto_digitales_berichtsheft_ue: Flextime account, digital report book & overtime calculator — free, offline, GDPR-compliant. Join more than 400 apprentices.

showcase.vier_handgriffe_und_der_tag: Four taps, and the day is logged.
showcase.kommen_pause_gehen_den_rest: Clock in, break, clock out — the app does the rest. By the end of the week the report book is almost finished.
showcase.ein_tap_auf_kommen_oder: One tap on „Clock in“ — or an NFC tag at your workstation. That is all the start takes.
showcase.die_pause_wird_abgezogen_nicht: The break is deducted, not estimated. The app knows the statutory minimum break.
showcase.mi_wartung_der_clients_im: Wed — Serviced the clients on the 2nd floor, prepared the image rollout. 8:30 h

actSteps.ein_tap_startet_den_livetracker: One tap starts the live tracker. No form, no sign-up, no waiting for a server. Prefer typing? Enter start and end by hand.
actSteps.pausen_zieht_myworklog_nach_deinen: MyWorkLog deducts breaks according to your settings — not a fixed number in the code. The statutory minimum break is built in and speaks up when it is missing.
actSteps.der_tag_wird_gegen_dein: The day is measured against your daily target, and the difference moves into your flextime account. Overtime and undertime show up right away — rounded, if your employer rounds.
actSteps.aus_den_eintraegen_der_woche: The week's entries become your training record — a PDF on the official form of your chamber. What you noted each day is already in it.

screens.dashboard_berichtsheft_und_recovery_cent: Dashboard, report book and Recovery Center — captured with sample data, exactly as the app looks today. On a computer and on a phone.
screens.woche_monat_gleitzeit_und_urlaub: Week, month, flextime and leave — every deviation on a visible zero line. On the phone the same app, installable, offline.
screens.jede_woche_mit_stand_und: Every week with status and hours, the year at a glance, the training record as a PDF on your chamber’s form.
screens.fruehere_staende_zurueckholen_oder_ein: Bring back earlier states or load a backup from a file — before something is missing, not after.
screens.dashboard_von_myworklog_am_rechner: MyWorkLog dashboard on a computer: figures for week, month, flextime and remaining leave, below them the balance trend and the distribution of working hours
screens.dashboard_von_myworklog_am_handy: MyWorkLog dashboard on a phone: the figures stacked, at the bottom the bar with Dashboard, Analysis, Report, History and More
screens.berichtsheft_von_myworklog_wochenstreak_: MyWorkLog report book: weekly streak, training progress, overview of the year with colours for draft, complete and signed, below it the list of weeks
screens.recovery_center_von_myworklog_liste: MyWorkLog Recovery Center: list of saved states with restore, merge and JSON export, below it the field for loading a backup file

features.alles_was_azubis_fuer_die: Everything apprentices need for time tracking
features.gleitzeitkonto_berichtsheft_ueberstunden: Flextime account, report book, overtime calculator — one app for everything around your apprenticeship.
features.livetracker_manueller_eintrag_oder_nfcta: Live tracker, manual entry or an NFC tag at your workstation. Shifts, multiple jobs, vocational school days and holidays are their own entry types — whether your training is technical, commercial or industrial.
features.der_ausbildungsnachweis_entsteht_aus_dei: Your training record is built from your entries and exported as a PDF on the official form of your chamber — DIHK template, revised version or Munich.
features.deine_eintraege_bleiben_im_browser: Your entries stay in your device's browser. Backups are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before the app even offers you the file.
features.ein_service_worker_haelt_die: A service worker keeps the whole app cached. No signal in the workshop? It still runs.
features.handy_und_pc_gleichen_sich: Phone and PC sync directly over WebRTC — device to device, with nothing in between.
features.heatmaps_wochen_und_jahresansicht_progno: Heatmaps, weekly and yearly views, forecasts. Your flextime account as a picture instead of a table.
features.der_ausbilder_legt_ein_konto: The trainer creates an account, connects to the company and signs off weeks with a digital signature — all of the company’s apprentices in one place, free of charge. Without an account, a single week can be countersigned via a link.
features.das_digitale_berichtsheft_der_ihk: The IHK’s digital report book ends on 31 December 2026. Its PDF export can be taken over directly — weeks, days, hours and sign-off status — and carried on in the same report book.
features.frist_export_und_import_schritt: Deadline, export and import step by step

durationTooltip.woher_kommt_die_zahl: Where does this number come from?
durationTooltip.die_mittlere_dauer_einer_sitzung: The average length of a session on myworklog.de, measured by this site’s web analytics.
durationTooltip.gezaehlt_wird_der_besuch_der: What is counted is the visit to the website — not the time spent in the app itself. That runs in your browser and reports nothing outward.

engagementTooltip.sitzungen_mit_mehr_als_einer: Sessions that open more than one page
engagementTooltip.gemessen_wird_verhalten_nicht_zufriedenh: What is measured is behaviour, not satisfaction: how many sessions click onward, and how far. Nobody was surveyed, so there is no score for that here.

values.drei_entscheidungen_die_jede_weitere: Three decisions that shape every other one.
values.deine_eintraege_bleiben_im_browser: Your entries stay in the browser — no account, no advertising pixels, no profiling. The anonymous usage statistics are cookie-free and publicly viewable.
values.jede_rechnung_im_gleitzeitkonto_ist: Every calculation in the flextime account is covered by tests. Where a number is uncertain, the app says so — instead of filling in the most plausible one.
values.kostenlos_und_ohne_anmeldung_werkzeuge: Free and without sign-up. Tools for an apprenticeship should not depend on what somebody can pay.

datenfluss.alles_laeuft_auf_deinem_geraet: Everything comes together on your device.
datenfluss.jede_funktion_liest_und_schreibt: Every feature reads and writes the same storage in your browser. Four paths lead outside — and each one only when you switch it on. Tap a building block to see what it reads and writes.

dftEintrag.kommen_pause_gehen_der_tag: Clock in, break, clock out — the day is stored as an entry. A half-finished entry stays as a draft.

dftTimer.laeuft_auch_bei_geschlossenem_tab: Keeps running with the tab closed, because the start time is stored — not a counter.

dftNfc.der_chip_traegt_nur_eine: The tag holds only an address, no data. Your phone opens the app; the entry is created here.
dftNfc.nichts_vom_chip_ausser_der: nothing from the tag except the address

dftImport.csv_excel_oder_zwischenablage_aus: CSV, Excel or the clipboard from another tool. The file is read in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

dftBerichtsheft.berichte_entwuerfe_und_die_angaben: Reports, drafts and the details for the IHK form. Pulls the hours from time tracking instead of asking twice.

dftSchule.schultage_faecher_und_noten_je: School days, subjects and grades per training year — part of your settings, not a separate account.

dftIhk.fehlzeiten_zulassung_vertragsende_gerech: Absences, exam admission, contract end — calculated from the entries that are already there.

dftUrlaub.resturlaub_in_tagen_oder_stunden: Remaining leave in days or hours. Every planned day becomes an entry like any other.

dftAufgaben.eigene_seite_mit_eigenen_schluesseln: Its own page with its own keys — separate from the times, but in the same browser.

dfHubLive.auf_diesem_geraet_liegt_noch: Nothing is stored on this device yet.

dftHub.ein_datensatz_fuer_eintraege_einstellung: One record for entries, settings and goals; the report book, the tasks and the timetable keep their own keys beside it. Clear the site data in your browser and everything is gone — hence the backup on the right.

dftVerlauf.jeder_tag_als_zeile_nach: Every day as a row, grouped by month. Editing writes back into the same record.

dftAnalyse.gleitzeitkonto_heatmaps_prognosen_alles_: Flextime account, heatmaps, forecasts — all calculated in the browser. Only how you set up the charts is stored.

dftZiele.wochen_und_monatsziele_stehen_in: Weekly and monthly goals live in the settings; progress is recalculated from the entries every time you open them.

dftExport.pdf_csv_oder_json_werden: PDF, CSV or JSON are generated in the browser and land as a file with you. Only the time is remembered, for the reminder.

dftOffline.haelt_die_appdateien_vor_damit: Keeps the app files ready so it starts without a network. It never touches your entries — those live elsewhere.
dftOffline.die_appdateien_nicht_deine_daten: the app files, not your data

dftAutosicherung.bei_jedem_speichern_legt_die: On every save the app keeps a copy of the record beside it. If the main record is damaged at start-up, it is restored from there.

dftBackup.der_ganze_datensatz_als_datei: The whole record as a file, encrypted with your password (AES-GCM, key via PBKDF2). Without the password the file is unreadable — for us too.

dfMap.ausserhalb_deines_geraets_nur_wenn: Outside your device — only when you switch it on
dfMap.liest_und_schreibt_auf_diesem: reads and writes on this device
dfMap.verlaesst_das_geraet_nur_auf: leaves the device — only at your request
dfMap.dazu_kommt_die_anonyme_cookiefreie: On top of that there is the anonymous, cookie-free usage statistic: it counts page views, not entries. And the shadow report book can additionally back up to your Google Drive on request — again only on click.

dftCloud.legst_du_ein_konto_an: If you create an account, the record is also stored on the sync server so a second device can fetch it. Access is limited to your account. Signing out applies to this device only.

dftP2p.zwei_geraete_reden_per_webrtc: Two devices talk to each other directly over WebRTC, end-to-end encrypted. The pairing code travels by QR or clipboard — no server sees your entries, and without comparing the check digits the channel stays closed.

dftKi.nur_was_du_im_kistudio: Only what you type into the AI studio goes through our proxy to the language model — and, if you switch on the "time tracking" source, the notes of the chosen week. The proxy holds the key, not your browser. Switched off, the generator runs locally.

dftUntis.holt_den_stundenplan_deiner_schule: Fetches your school's timetable through a proxy that only passes the request on. Nothing flows the other way: your entries stay here.

journey.von_der_ersten_idee_bis: From the first idea until today.

jrP1.aus_dem_aerger_ueber_umstaendliche: Annoyance at clumsy time tracking at work turned into a prototype: one page that captures a working day in two taps.

jrP2.myworklog_geht_als_progressive_web: MyWorkLog goes live as a progressive web app — offline-first, no account, no server in the data path.

jrP3.regelbasierte_analysen_heatmaps_und_prog: Rule-based analyses, heatmaps and forecasts arrive — and the report book learns the official forms of the chambers.

jrP4.ueber_400_azubis_erfassen_ihre: More than 400 apprentices track their hours with MyWorkLog. Since then it has gained NFC clock-in, device sync over WebRTC and the import bridge from other tools.

team.schreibt_myworklog_neben_der_eigenen: Builds MyWorkLog alongside his own apprenticeship — and uses it every day.
